# LGD fixture

`Districts_of_Uttar_Pradesh_State.pdf`: the LGD "Districts of a State" export for Uttar
Pradesh, downloaded 2026-11-21 from https://lgdirectory.gov.in/ and used unchanged to test
`src/up_siting/extract/lgd.py`.

**Attribution.** Local Government Directory, Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of
India, published under the Government Open Data License – India (GODL-India), which allows
redistribution with attribution. See `docs/data-sources.md`.
